observation.meta.tool_name.description: Tool name list; defines ordering for tool-visible and 2D pose arrays.

observation.meta.tool_visible.description: Per-tool visibility flag for the 2D pose.

observation.state.tool_pose_2d.description: Per-tool 2D pose [tx,ty,theta] aligned with tool_name ordering. NaN if not visible.

observation.meta.depth_npz_relpath.description: Relative path to raw depth .npz under raw/depth/episode_xxxxxx/ (only present when depth exists).

observation.meta.seg_png_relpath.description: Relative path to raw label_map png under raw/seg/episode_xxxxxx/ (only present when segmentation exists).

notes.truncation_policy: n_steps = min(counts over available modalities: rgb, toolposes, and optionally depth/seg if present)
notes.depth_storage: raw npz per frame + depth_vis video for viewing (only if depth is available)
notes.seg_storage: raw label_map png per frame + part_id video for viewing (only if segmentation is available)
